question.text: Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) are now regulated by:

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation of Housing Finance Companies was earlier with the National Housing Bank and has now been taken over by the Reserve Bank of India. RBI now frames the detailed guidelines applicable to HFCs. The Trap: NHB was the earlier regulator, which is a common exam distractor. The transfer of supervisory responsibility to RBI is the source-stated position. Note: Source basis is p.95 of the NISM-Series-X-A Investment Adviser (Level 1) workbook (June 2025).
